workstream: Wave 3C-1f1 — Implement core social and city-owned facilities
scope: Implement five verified current public-facing social/community/city-owned destinations only.

implementationNotes.makatiYouthCenter: Current point and historical/current address evidence place the facility on J.P. Rizal in Guadalupe Viejo.
implementationNotes.poblacionPublicMarket: Implemented as the current Poblacion Wet & Dry Market at 6022 Escuela / J.D. Villena, not any same-named market in another city.
implementationNotes.coLocationRule: This batch deliberately excludes day-care and child-minding services inside barangay halls; those will be reconciled against host buildings before implementation.

nextStep.title: Implement co-location-aware day-care and child-minding coverage
nextStep.scope: Resolve the 22 current day-care centers + 1 child-minding center against host buildings/barangay facilities, then implement only distinct useful Civic Map assets without duplicate-building clutter.
